subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.-----PER.TRS.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 318 (R(AS)CM(I)-2). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject; PER-TRS (perceived transition) is the partner. From the subject: STR. From STR: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From APP-RDEF: EXT-F (extended functionalism), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From EXT-F: ASP-ES (aspect essence), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and AFTF (affinity transfer). From ASP-ES: AFL (affinity alignment). From AFTF: AF-TD (affinity tendencies).
